Name: Southpaw
Details:
Daughter of Terry Ford and Alexandra Steward. Lisa decided to leave the Ninth Illician Rangers and pursue her own path. Her father has always been a sore point of contention due his passing solidifying his legacy as a laughingstock of the family.

Her fondest memories as a young child were riding in her father's lap as he took his 'bouncy' Charger for a stroll. She hyphenates her name to distance herself from the embarassment yet she still retains her father's preference for melee mechs when stepping onto the battlefield.
